graphviz: 15.1.0, compiled to WebAssembly inside graphviz.umd.js. The wasm is embedded in that one file, so a plain script tag works with no bundler and no second fetch -- the same shape as the deck.gl vendoring. All seven engines are compiled in: dot, neato, fdp, circo, twopi, osage, patchwork.
why-graphviz-draws: dot with pack=true packs disconnected components instead of laying them out in a row. Measured on Mensores: pkg:cli goes from 11991x514 (23:1) under Mermaid's dagre to 782x744 (1.1:1), and from 2.5 s to 83 ms. dagre has no component-packing, aspect-ratio or width option at all. Pass pack=true ALONE -- size merely scales a finished drawing and ratio fights the packing.
why-mermaid-stays: Mermaid is kept to EMIT source a reader can copy into other tools. It does not draw. If it is ever made to draw again it must be initialised htmlLabels:false -- an SVG carrying <foreignObject> refuses to rasterise into a canvas, so anything built from one is silently blank.
